question: Do package metadata or the named primary supplement explicitly reconcile EM entry counts with Fig1/Fig7 caption counts?
expected_outcomes: demonstrated package reading error with preserved correction

bounds.workbooks: two already cached files only; verify hashes before use

checks: all cell types, numeric validity and finite positive area values
internal blanks versus trailing padding; row and column provenance
hidden rows/columns, styles, names, comments, package metadata
source-provided inclusion rules and cell/culture/date/condition mapping
explicit evidence only for count reconciliation; CLEM exclusion not assumed to apply to EM
stop_condition: One independently reviewed explanation or unresolved discrepancy. No imputation, changed denominators, morphology effects, p-values, trajectories or mechanics fit. If unresolved, stop figure reproduction without another search.
